items.name: agent-chat
items.title: Agent Chat
items.description: A full chat surface over useChatTranscript — welcome state with mode pills, a composer card with a context strip, message bubbles, grouped tool cards, a reasoning disclosure, provenance from retrieval, follow-ups and stick-to-bottom.
items.author: Davide Carvalho <https://github.com/DavideCarvalho>

items.name: agent-chat-composer
items.title: Agent Chat Composer
items.description: The composer card on its own — growing textarea, attach affordance, a slot for a model picker, one control that submits or cancels the turn in flight, a context strip and mode pills.
items.author: Davide Carvalho <https://github.com/DavideCarvalho>
